_about: Shared by backend/tests/services/test_facility_placement_cases.py and frontend/features/s1/tests/facilityPlacementCases.test.tsx. Each case is one document with one or more records. A field is [value, status]; status is rule (read by the rules, not reviewed), ai_only (read only by Claude, nobody accepted it), accepted (Claude read it and a reviewer accepted it), rejected or needs_more_evidence (a reviewer decided against using it). expect.facility has one entry per record: the Setup facility id it is placed on, or null. expect.note has one entry per record: null, or text the plain-sentence note must contain.
